s0301.literal: A planning commission for the various routes of Yunnan was established, with Shams al-Din as commissioner.
s0301.idiomatic: A planning commission for Yunnan's various routes was established, with Shams al-Din as commissioner.

s0302.literal: Additional troops were added to escort Tang Yongjian; Yongjian asked that Bayidu and Mangudai go with him, and it was granted.
s0302.idiomatic: Additional troops were added to escort Tang Yongjian; Yongjian asked that Bayidu and Mangudai accompany him, and the request was granted.

s0303.literal: An edict ordered the recovery of thirty-four gold and silver tallies from the princes Haidu and Baraq.
s0303.idiomatic: An edict ordered the recovery of thirty-four gold and silver tallies from the princes Haidu and Baraq.

s0304.literal: In the second month, on guimao day, the great army halted at Anqing Prefecture; Song Commander of the Front Palace Guard and Anqing prefect Fan Wenhu surrendered the city; Bayan, acting on commission, appointed Wenhu Grand Commander of the Two Zhes.
s0304.idiomatic: In the second month, on guimao day, the great army halted at Anqing Prefecture; Song commander of the Front Palace Guard and Anqing prefect Fan Wenhu surrendered the city; Bayan, acting on commission, appointed Wenhu grand commander of the Two Zhes.

s0305.literal: On jiachen day Right Associate of the Central Secretariat Borolqu was made commander-in-chief of Huaidong, and Right Associate Ariq left vice commander-in-chief.
s0305.idiomatic: On jiachen day right associate Borolqu was made commander-in-chief of Huaidong, and right associate Ariq left vice commander-in-chief.

s0306.literal: Ariq, Sagis, and others were further ordered to assemble their Mongol and Han forces at Pi Prefecture.
s0306.idiomatic: Ariq, Sagis, and others were further ordered to assemble their Mongol and Han forces at Pi Prefecture.

s0307.literal: Garrison troops from Qi and Su were also dispatched, and one thousand Henan war vessels were sent thither.
s0307.idiomatic: Garrison troops from Qi and Su were also dispatched, and one thousand Henan war vessels were sent thither.

s0308.literal: Bitchigchi Boluo was sent to audit Western Xia monopoly levies; the Kaiyuan pacification commission was ordered to relieve famine among newly submitted Kirghiz people.
s0308.idiomatic: Bitchigchi Boluo was sent to audit Western Xia monopoly levies; the Kaiyuan pacification commission was ordered to relieve famine among newly submitted Kirghiz people.

s0309.literal: An edict forbade hunting pregnant wild beasts in Uyghur lands in spring and summer.
s0309.idiomatic: An edict forbade hunting pregnant wild beasts in Uyghur lands in spring and summer.

s0310.literal: An Earth Queen shrine was established at Linfen in Pingyang; temples to Fuxi, Nüwa, Shun, Tang, the River Spirit, and others at Hezhong, Jie Prefecture, Hongdong, and Zhao Prefecture.
s0310.idiomatic: An Earth Queen shrine was established at Linfen in Pingyang; temples to Fuxi, Nüwa, Shun, Tang, the River Spirit, and others were established at Hezhong, Jie Prefecture, Hongdong, and Zhao Prefecture.

s0311.literal: On bingwu day the great army halted at Chizhou; Song acting prefect Zhao Maofa hanged himself; commander-in-chief Zhang Lin surrendered the city.
s0311.idiomatic: On bingwu day the great army halted at Chizhou; Song acting prefect Zhao Maofa hanged himself; commander-in-chief Zhang Lin surrendered the city.

s0312.literal: The Western Xia Zhongxing circuit transport office was merged into the circuit governor's office.
s0312.idiomatic: The Western Xia Zhongxing circuit transport office was merged into the circuit governor's office.

s0313.literal: It was proposed to exchange Zhongtong notes for Song exchange notes, and to release Cai Prefecture salt to trade for medicinal materials.
s0313.idiomatic: It was proposed to exchange Zhongtong notes for Song exchange notes and to release Cai Prefecture salt to trade for medicinal materials.

s0314.literal: On dingwei day unregistered volunteers were forbidden to plunder newly submitted civilians and soldiers returning to their occupations.
s0314.idiomatic: On dingwei day unregistered volunteers were forbidden to plunder newly submitted civilians and soldiers returning to their occupations.

s0315.literal: On wushen day an edict instructed officials, gentry, commoners, soldiers, artisans, monks, and Taoists who had submitted at Jiang, Huang, E, Yue, Hanyang, Anqing, and other places: let farmers return to the plow, merchants to the road, laity and clergy each to their own occupations; if garrison officials should arbitrarily harass them, they were to report it to the mobile Central Secretariat.
s0315.idiomatic: On wushen day an edict instructed officials, gentry, commoners, soldiers, artisans, monks, and Taoists who had submitted at Jiang, Huang, E, Yue, Hanyang, Anqing, and other places to return farmers to the plow and merchants to the road, and to let laity and clergy each resume their own occupations; if garrison officials harassed them, they were to report it to the mobile Central Secretariat.

s0317.literal: You Xian and Yang Tingxun were summoned to court.
s0317.idiomatic: You Xian and Yang Tingxun were summoned to court.

s0318.literal: Huo Sheng and Zhang He, who had submitted suggestions, were granted ten ingots of notes apiece to follow the Huaidong commander-in-chief south on campaign.
s0318.idiomatic: Huo Sheng and Zhang He, who had submitted suggestions, were granted ten ingots of notes apiece to follow the Huaidong commander-in-chief south on campaign.

s0319.literal: On gengxu day Vice Minister of Rites Du Shizhong and Bureau Director of War He Wenzhao were dispatched bearing a letter as envoys to Japan.
s0319.idiomatic: On gengxu day vice minister of rites Du Shizhong and bureau director of war He Wenzhao were dispatched bearing a letter as envoys to Japan.

s0320.literal: On xinhai day Associate Prefect of Jinan Zhang Hanying was sent with an edict to instruct Huaidong military commissioner Li Tingzhi.
s0320.idiomatic: On xinhai day associate prefect of Jinan Zhang Hanying was sent with an edict to instruct Huaidong military commissioner Li Tingzhi.

s0321.literal: On renzi day Luoci circuit governor Jiang Yi captured four peasants including Hao Jin who spread sorcery talk to delude the masses; an edict ordered Jin executed and the rest spared from death but exiled afar.
s0321.idiomatic: On renzi day Luoci circuit governor Jiang Yi captured four peasants including Hao Jin who spread sorcery talk to delude the masses; an edict ordered Jin executed and the rest spared from death but exiled afar.

s0322.literal: Song Grand Councilor Jia Sidao sent Planning Commissioner Song Jing and Commissioner-in-chief Ruan Sicong to the branch secretariat, requesting the return of surrendered prefectures and offering annual tribute.
s0322.idiomatic: Song grand councilor Jia Sidao sent planning commissioner Song Jing and commissioner-in-chief Ruan Sicong to the branch secretariat, requesting the return of surrendered prefectures and offering annual tribute.

s0323.literal: Bayan had Nangadai return with Ruan Sicong to report; Song Jing was kept waiting; the envoy told Sidao: "Before crossing the river, tribute and peace talks were possible; now all riverside prefectures have submitted—if you want peace, you must come in person to discuss it.
s0323.idiomatic: Bayan had Nangadai return with Ruan Sicong to report and kept Song Jing waiting; the envoy told Sidao: "Before crossing the river, tribute and peace talks were possible; now all riverside prefectures have submitted—if you want peace, you must come in person to discuss it.

s0324.literal: " Nangadai returned, and Song Jing was released.
s0324.idiomatic: " Nangadai returned, and Song Jing was released.

s0325.literal: Associate Privy Councillor Ni Dezheng was sent to E Prefecture to manage finances.
s0325.idiomatic: Associate privy councillor Ni Dezheng was sent to E Prefecture to manage finances.

s0326.literal: On guichou day censors impeached former Nanjing route governor Tian Dacheng for marrying his younger brother's wife Zhao, violating human relations; an edict ordered eighty strokes of the staff and exclusion from office for three years.
s0326.idiomatic: On guichou day censors impeached former Nanjing route governor Tian Dacheng for marrying his younger brother's wife Zhao, violating human relations; an edict ordered eighty strokes of the staff and exclusion from office for three years.

s0327.literal: As Dacheng was already dead, only Zhao was beaten eighty strokes in the marketplace.
s0327.idiomatic: As Dacheng was already dead, only Zhao was beaten eighty strokes in the marketplace.

s0328.literal: On bingchen day brocade silk, bows and arrows, and saddles and bridles were granted for Japan campaign merit in the eastern expedition command.
s0328.idiomatic: On bingchen day brocade silk, bows and arrows, and saddles and bridles were granted for Japan campaign merit in the eastern expedition command.

s0329.literal: On gengshen day Tabudai and Orlu were sent to summon surrendered E-Han officials Zhang Yanran and others to court, and also instructed them: "I have considered your memorial which states: 'Song's powerful ministers did not keep the old treaty and detained envoys—this is truly not the Song emperor's fault. If only the sage compassion would punish only those who exceeded their authority and not let the Zhao house go without sacrifices.'
s0329.idiomatic: On gengshen day Tabudai and Orlu were sent to summon surrendered E-Han officials Zhang Yanran and others to court, and also instructed them: "I have considered your memorial, which says: 'Song's powerful ministers broke the old treaty and detained envoys—this is truly not the Song emperor's fault. If Your Majesty in mercy would punish only those who acted on their own authority and not leave the Zhao house without heirs,'

s0331.literal: Since you have not forgotten your former sovereign, you will certainly be able to assist and support Our house.
s0331.idiomatic: Since you have not forgotten your former sovereign, you will certainly be able to assist and support Our house.

s0332.literal: Since your memorial came up, Bayan has already halted the army's advance and still sent Minister of War Lian Xixian and others with a letter; if they can repent and come over, what past fault would We investigate?
s0332.idiomatic: Since your memorial came up, Bayan has already halted the army's advance and still sent minister of war Lian Xixian and others with a letter; if they can repent and come over, what past fault would We investigate?

s0333.literal: As for the powerful minister Jia Sidao, if he still lacks even a mind to confess guilt, how much less would he allow the Zhao house to lack sacrifices?
s0333.idiomatic: As for the powerful minister Jia Sidao, if he still lacks even a mind to confess guilt, how much less would he allow the Zhao house to lack sacrifices?

s0334.literal: If they obstinately refuse to repent, on matters not yet come to pass, what can We say—may Heaven witness it."
s0334.idiomatic: If they obstinately refuse to repent, on matters not yet come to pass, what can We say—may Heaven witness it."

s0335.literal: On xinyou day Kuokuo was ordered to lead his thousand troops and five hundred personal followers under Ala Haiya's command.
s0335.idiomatic: On xinyou day Kuokuo was ordered to lead his thousand troops and five hundred personal followers under Ala Haiya's command.

s0336.literal: For all Hunan prefectures and counties and people along the water who came over, Kuokuo was to command them; those who resisted and did not submit were to be gathered by persuasion.
s0336.idiomatic: For all Hunan prefectures and counties and people along the water who came over, Kuokuo was to command them; those who resisted and did not submit were to be gathered by persuasion.

s0337.literal: An edict ordered refugees from Da Hongshan to return to Hanyang and resume farming; Ala Haiya was ordered to garrison there.
s0337.idiomatic: An edict ordered refugees from Da Hongshan to return to Hanyang and resume farming; Ala Haiya was ordered to garrison there.

s0338.literal: Ashihan, Tang Yongjian, Qi Gongzhi, and others were again ordered with Tölie to lead a thousand armored cavalry bearing an edict to summon Ying Prefecture.
s0338.idiomatic: Ashihan, Tang Yongjian, Qi Gongzhi, and others were again ordered with Tölie to lead a thousand armored cavalry bearing an edict to summon Ying Prefecture.

s0339.literal: The great army halted at Dingjiazhou; war vessels covered the river downstream.
s0339.idiomatic: The great army halted at Dingjiazhou; war vessels covered the river downstream.

s0340.literal: Song Jia Sidao sent infantry commander Sun Huchen and army controller Su Liuyi to gather troops north and south of the river; Sidao with Huaidong commissioner Xia Gui commanded the rear army.
s0340.idiomatic: Song Jia Sidao sent infantry commander Sun Huchen and army controller Su Liuyi to gather troops north and south of the river; Sidao with Huaidong commissioner Xia Gui commanded the rear army.

s0341.literal: More than two thousand five hundred war vessels spanned the river.
s0341.idiomatic: More than two thousand five hundred war vessels spanned the river.

s0342.literal: The next day Bayan ordered left and right wing wanhu to lead cavalry advancing along both banks, then ordered trebuchets to strike them.
s0342.idiomatic: The next day Bayan ordered left and right wing wanhu to lead cavalry advancing along both banks, then ordered trebuchets to strike them.

s0343.literal: The Song formation moved; Xia Gui fled first; Sidao, in confusion, sounded gongs and dispersed the armies; the Song army was completely routed.
s0343.idiomatic: The Song formation moved; Xia Gui fled first; Sidao, in confusion, sounded gongs and dispersed the armies; the Song army was completely routed.

s0344.literal: Aju commanded with pacifier He Wei, Li Ting, and others—fleet and infantry and cavalry—and pursued one hundred fifty li, seizing more than two thousand vessels along with military goods, maps, and seals; Sidao fled east to Yangzhou.
s0344.idiomatic: Aju commanded with pacifier He Wei, Li Ting, and others—fleet and infantry and cavalry—and pursued one hundred fifty li, seizing more than two thousand vessels along with military goods, maps, and seals; Sidao fled east to Yangzhou.

s0345.literal: Ai Xianbuhua said: "Xia Gui let northern army commander Yue Quan return, claiming intent to submit internally—we should send an imperial letter to summon him.
s0345.idiomatic: Ai Xianbuhua said: "Xia Gui let northern army commander Yue Quan return, claiming intent to submit internally—we should send an imperial letter to summon him.

s0346.literal: " His nephew Hu Yinglei was then sent with an edict to instruct him.
s0346.idiomatic: " His nephew Hu Yinglei was then sent with an edict to instruct him.

s0347.literal: On jiazi day the great army halted at Wuhu County; Song Jiangdong transport judge and Taiping prefect Meng Zhijing surrendered the city.
s0347.idiomatic: On jiazi day the great army halted at Wuhu County; Song Jiangdong transport judge and Taiping prefect Meng Zhijing surrendered the city.

s0348.literal: Commander-in-chief Borolqu halted at Haizhou; prefect Ding Shun surrendered the city.
s0348.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Borolqu halted at Haizhou; prefect Ding Shun surrendered the city.

s0349.literal: On yichou day Ala Haiya said: "Jiangling is a great Song stronghold on the upper Yangtze with hundreds of thousands of elite troops—if we do not take it with this momentum like splitting bamboo, when the river floods even E-Han cities may be hard to hold.
s0349.idiomatic: On yichou day Ala Haiya said: "Jiangling is a great Song stronghold on the upper Yangtze with hundreds of thousands of elite troops—if we do not take it with this momentum like splitting bamboo, when the river floods even E-Han cities may be hard to hold.

s0350.literal: " The request was granted; an imperial letter was still sent and envoys dispatched to instruct the Jiangling commissioner and officials under Gao Da.
s0350.idiomatic: " The request was granted; an imperial letter was still sent and envoys dispatched to instruct the Jiangling commissioner and officials under Gao Da.

s0351.literal: Song Fuzhou regimental trainer and Temmo commissioner Nong Shigui, together with the prefects of thirty-seven counties and one hundred thousand households, came to the Yunnan branch secretariat to surrender.
s0351.idiomatic: Song Fuzhou regimental trainer and Temmo commissioner Nong Shigui, together with the prefects of thirty-seven counties and one hundred thousand households, came to the Yunnan branch secretariat to surrender.

s0352.literal: On bingyin day the Privy Council said: "At the start of the river crossing Bozhou wanhu Shi Ge and Piyang wanhu Shimo Shozu failed through reckless advance—punishment is requested.
s0352.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Privy Council said: "At the start of the river crossing Bozhou wanhu Shi Ge and Piyang wanhu Shimo Shozu failed through reckless advance—punishment is requested.

s0353.literal: " An imperial order stated that some were to be punished with reduced rank and some to redeem themselves by merit; the branch secretariat was to decide.
s0353.idiomatic: " An imperial order stated that some were to be punished with reduced rank and some to redeem themselves by merit; the branch secretariat was to decide.

s0354.literal: Private gambling was forbidden; offenders were exiled to the north.
s0354.idiomatic: Private gambling was forbidden; offenders were exiled to the north.

s0355.literal: On wuchen day the army halted at Caishi; He Prefecture prefect Wang Shan surrendered the city.
s0355.idiomatic: On wuchen day the army halted at Caishi; He Prefecture prefect Wang Shan surrendered the city.

s0356.literal: Commander-in-chief Borolqu halted at Lianshui; Song prefect Sun Siwu surrendered the city.
s0356.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Borolqu halted at Lianshui; Song prefect Sun Siwu surrendered the city.

s0357.literal: On jisi day Boshu, Tang Yongjian, and others were again sent to proclaim to the officials, gentry, and commoners of Ying Prefecture.
s0357.idiomatic: On jisi day Boshu, Tang Yongjian, and others were again sent to proclaim to the officials, gentry, and commoners of Ying Prefecture.

s0358.literal: On gengwu day the great army halted at Jiankang; Song riverine commissioner Zhao Yin fled south; commanders Xu Wangrong, Weng Fu, Mao Shixiong, and garrison commander Cao Wang surrendered the city.
s0358.idiomatic: On gengwu day the great army halted at Jiankang; Song riverine commissioner Zhao Yin fled south; commanders Xu Wangrong, Weng Fu, Mao Shixiong, and garrison commander Cao Wang surrendered the city.

s0359.literal: Song Jia Sidao reached Yangzhou and then sent director Duan You to return credentialed envoys Hao Jing, Liu Renjie, and others.
s0359.idiomatic: Song Jia Sidao reached Yangzhou and then sent director Duan You to return credentialed envoys Hao Jing, Liu Renjie, and others.

s0360.literal: An edict ordered the Privy Council to welcome Jing and the others by water route to court.
s0360.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Privy Council to welcome Jing and the others by water route to court.

s0361.literal: An edict to King Chen Guangbing of Annam again instructed him on the six traditional matters and urged him to come to court.
s0361.idiomatic: An edict to King Chen Guangbing of Annam again instructed him on the six traditional matters and urged him to come to court.

s0362.literal: Keshik Danchaqan, deputy protocol officer Guan Siyi, and Taoist Li Dehe were appointed to substitute-sacrifice to the mountains, rivers, and Earth Queen.
s0362.idiomatic: Keshik Danchaqan, deputy protocol officer Guan Siyi, and Taoist Li Dehe were appointed to substitute-sacrifice to the mountains, rivers, and Earth Queen.

s0363.literal: The imperial procession proceeded to Shangdu.
s0363.idiomatic: The imperial procession proceeded to Shangdu.

s0364.literal: In the third month, on the renshen new moon, Song Zhenjiang cavalry commander Shi Zuzhong surrendered the city.
s0364.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renshen new moon, Song Zhenjiang cavalry commander Shi Zuzhong surrendered the city.

s0365.literal: The branch secretariat separately dispatched Huaidong branch Atahai to garrison Jingkou.
s0365.idiomatic: The branch secretariat separately dispatched Huaidong branch Atahai to garrison Jingkou.

s0366.literal: Song executed palace commander Han Zhen; his officers Li Daming and two hundred men brought Zhen's mother, wife, and sons Wen Yu and Wen Can from Lin'an to defect.
s0366.idiomatic: Song executed palace commander Han Zhen; his officers Li Daming and two hundred men brought Zhen's mother, wife, and sons Wen Yu and Wen Can from Lin'an to defect.

s0367.literal: On jiaxu day Song Jiangyin military judge Li Shixiu surrendered the city.
s0367.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Song Jiangyin military judge Li Shixiu surrendered the city.

s0368.literal: On yihai day the Privy Council was instructed: "Recently commander Huoniu Chi was sent to campaign in Chang Hexi, with vice commander Tan Ching guarding Jiandu, given an imperial letter to settle the people.
s0368.idiomatic: On yihai day the Privy Council was instructed: "Recently commander Huoniu Chi was sent to campaign in Chang Hexi, with vice commander Tan Ching guarding Jiandu, given an imperial letter to settle the people.

s0369.literal: " An edict also ordered Prince Mangqalai of Anxi, Prince Jebek Temür, and son-in-law Chaghi to dispatch their Mongol troops to follow Prince Orluk of Xi Ping against Tibet.
s0369.idiomatic: " An edict also ordered Prince Mangqalai of Anxi, Prince Jebek Temür, and son-in-law Chaghi to dispatch their Mongol troops to follow Prince Orluk of Xi Ping against Tibet.

s0370.literal: Wan Zhizhong and Tang Yongjian, together with the previously sent Ashihan and others, were ordered to lead a thousand elite troops to summon Ying Prefecture: if it submitted, garrison it;
s0370.idiomatic: Wan Zhizhong and Tang Yongjian, together with the previously sent Ashihan and others, were ordered to lead a thousand elite troops to summon Ying Prefecture: if it submitted, garrison it;

s0371.literal: if it did not submit, go by land and meet Ala Haiya and Hubulai at Jingnan.
s0371.idiomatic: if it did not submit, go by land and meet Ala Haiya and Hubulai at Jingnan.

s0372.literal: On bingzi day credentialed envoys Lian Xixian and others reached Jiankang and relayed an order that the generals each guard their camps and not plunder recklessly.
s0372.idiomatic: On bingzi day credentialed envoys Lian Xixian and others reached Jiankang and relayed an order that the generals each guard their camps and not plunder recklessly.

s0373.literal: Song Chuzhou prefect Wang Wenhu surrendered the city.
s0373.idiomatic: Song Chuzhou prefect Wang Wenhu surrendered the city.

s0374.literal: On wuyin day the Prince of Anxi was granted eight thousand bolts of cloth and ten thousand jin of silk.
s0374.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Prince of Anxi was granted eight thousand bolts of cloth and ten thousand jin of silk.

s0375.literal: On jimao day Pingyin County's Xinzhen Stockade was changed to Feicheng County and placed under Jining Prefecture.
s0375.idiomatic: On jimao day Pingyin County's Xinzhen Stockade was changed to Feicheng County and placed under Jining Prefecture.

s0376.literal: On gengchen day Song Ningguo prefect Yan Shaoqing surrendered the city.
s0376.idiomatic: On gengchen day Song Ningguo prefect Yan Shaoqing surrendered the city.

s0377.literal: Jiangdong Circuit gained two prefectures, five departments, two armies, and forty-three counties, with eight hundred thirty-one thousand eight hundred fifty-two households and one million nine hundred nineteen thousand one hundred six persons.
s0377.idiomatic: Jiangdong Circuit gained two prefectures, five departments, two armies, and forty-three counties, with 831,852 households and 1,919,106 persons.

s0378.literal: On jiashen day Huaiyuan and Lingwu counties were established at Zhongxing Route to settle more than four thousand eight hundred new households.
s0378.idiomatic: On jiashen day Huaiyuan and Lingwu counties were established at Zhongxing Route to settle more than four thousand eight hundred new households.

s0379.literal: On bingxu day Song Changzhou pacifier Dai Zhita and vice prefect Wang Huchen surrendered the city.
s0379.idiomatic: On bingxu day Song Changzhou pacifier Dai Zhita and vice prefect Wang Huchen surrendered the city.

s0380.literal: Credentialed envoys Lian Xixian, Yan Zhongfan, and others reached Dusong Pass in Song Guangde Army and were killed by the Song.
s0380.idiomatic: Credentialed envoys Lian Xixian, Yan Zhongfan, and others reached Dusong Pass in Song Guangde Army and were killed by the Song.

s0381.literal: On dinghai day miscellaneous military levies in all routes were remitted.
s0381.idiomatic: On dinghai day miscellaneous military levies in all routes were remitted.

s0382.literal: On xinmao day Song general Gao Shijie reoccupied Yue Prefecture and held Meng Zhijing's wife and children hostage;
s0382.idiomatic: On xinmao day Song general Gao Shijie reoccupied Yue Prefecture and held Meng Zhijing's wife and children hostage;

s0383.literal: he also took the wife and children of Fu Prefecture surrendered general Zhai Gui and sent them to Jiangling.
s0383.idiomatic: he also took the wife and children of Fu Prefecture surrendered general Zhai Gui and sent them to Jiangling.

s0384.literal: Shijie assembled thousands of war vessels from Ying, Fu, and Yue prefectures and upstream armies, with tens of thousands of troops, blocking the mouth of Jingjiang.
s0384.idiomatic: Shijie assembled thousands of war vessels from Ying, Fu, and Yue prefectures and upstream armies, with tens of thousands of troops, blocking the mouth of Jingjiang.

s0385.literal: On renchen day Ala Haiya encamped on the east bank; Shijie fled at midnight; at dawn he reached Dongting Lake mouth, with vessels lined in formation.
s0385.idiomatic: On renchen day Ala Haiya encamped on the east bank; Shijie fled at midnight; at dawn he reached Dongting Lake mouth, with vessels lined in formation.

s0386.literal: Ala Haiya supervised the wing wanhu and naval commanders Zhang Rongshi and Jie Ruji, pursued Shijie at Hutan in the lake mouth, and sent bureau director Zhang Ding to summon Shijie; Shijie surrendered.
s0386.idiomatic: Ala Haiya supervised the wing wanhu and naval commanders Zhang Rongshi and Jie Ruji, pursued Shijie at Hutan in the lake mouth, and sent bureau director Zhang Ding to summon Shijie; Shijie surrendered.

s0387.literal: Ala Haiya used Shijie to summon Yue Prefecture, and Meng Zhijing also surrendered the city.
s0387.idiomatic: Ala Haiya used Shijie to summon Yue Prefecture, and Meng Zhijing also surrendered the city.

s0388.literal: Because Shijie surrendered under duress, he was executed.
s0388.idiomatic: Because Shijie surrendered under duress, he was executed.

s0389.literal: The Prince of Beiping Nanhumai's command was granted two thousand one hundred eighty horses and three hundred sheep.
s0389.idiomatic: The Prince of Beiping Nanhumai's command was granted two thousand one hundred eighty horses and three hundred sheep.

s0390.literal: On guisi day garrison troops at Tancheng, Yizhou, and Shizi Road were ordered to follow Borolqu against Huainan.
s0390.idiomatic: On guisi day garrison troops at Tancheng, Yizhou, and Shizi Road were ordered to follow Borolqu against Huainan.

s0391.literal: On bingshen day Sidebu Tibetan official Tashi, Quezhou Tibetan official Zhuangliao Nanchejia, and others led forty-three tribes and five thousand one hundred sixty households to the Sichuan branch privy council to submit.
s0391.idiomatic: On bingshen day Sidebu Tibetan official Tashi, Quezhou Tibetan official Zhuangliao Nanchejia, and others led forty-three tribes and five thousand one hundred sixty households to the Sichuan branch privy council to submit.

s0392.literal: On wuxu day Shandong route commissioner Wang Yan was sent to garrison Yue Prefecture.
s0392.idiomatic: On wuxu day Shandong route commissioner Wang Yan was sent to garrison Yue Prefecture.

s0393.literal: On gengzi day, following the request of Wang Pan, Dou Mo, and others, a separate Hanlin Academy was established to manage Mongol script, with Hanlin Academician Sadimidir as its head.
s0393.idiomatic: On gengzi day, following the request of Wang Pan, Dou Mo, and others, a separate Hanlin Academy was established to manage Mongol script, with Hanlin academician Sadimidir as its head.

s0394.literal: The Hanlin combined with the National History Academy still edited the national history, drafted decrees, and served as advisers, with Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Huluhuosun concurrently editing the 《Court Diary》 and ritual.
s0394.idiomatic: The Hanlin Academy combined with the National History Academy still compiled the national history, drafted edicts, and served as advisers, with Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Huluhuosun concurrently editing the 《Court Diary》 and overseeing ritual.

s0395.literal: On xinchou day an edict ordered Aju to divide his forces and take Yangzhou.
s0395.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict ordered Aju to divide his forces and take Yangzhou.

s0396.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the renyin new moon, those who had merit and those who died in the campaign against Chang Hexi under Bila Chong were rewarded with gold, silver, notes, cloth, and silk in varying amounts.
s0396.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renyin new moon, those who had merit and those who died in the campaign against Chang Hexi under Bila Chong were rewarded with gold, silver, notes, cloth, and silk in varying amounts.

s0397.literal: On yisi day the Western Xia Zhongxing circuit surveillance commission was changed to Longyou Hexi Circuit.
s0397.idiomatic: On yisi day the Western Xia Zhongxing circuit surveillance commission was changed to Longyou Hexi Circuit.

s0398.literal: On bingwu day Lianzhou, Xincheng, and Qinghe relay stations were established.
s0398.idiomatic: On bingwu day Lianzhou, Xincheng, and Qinghe relay stations were established.

s0399.literal: Ala Haiya encamped at Nanshi in Jiangling city, attacked its palisade, broke it, and Jingmen military commissioner Liu Mao surrendered.
s0399.idiomatic: Ala Haiya encamped at Nanshi in Jiangling city, attacked its palisade, broke it, and Jingmen military commissioner Liu Mao surrendered.

s0400.literal: On dingwei day Ala Haiya sent bureau director Zhang Ding bearing an edict into Jiangling; Song Jing-Hu commissioner Zhu Yisun, Hubei deputy commissioner Gao Da, and Jingxi-Hubei chief judicial officers Qingyang Meng Yan and Li Mo finally came out to surrender.
